sort_strategy.source_behavior: ExternalSorter::in_mem_sort_stream concatenates buffered batches when reservation size is below sort_in_place_threshold_bytes; otherwise it sorts separate batches and merges their streams. The default is 1 MiB. BatchBuilder already retains and drains its index vector. It retains the latest input batch for each stream, while SortPreservingMergeStream keeps previous cursors until its owner is dropped.
sort_strategy.interpretation: Most returned heap bytes follow frees during merge stream destruction. A triggering free can coalesce older free regions; returned byte counts do not measure the freed object size or assign ownership of every returned page. In these traces, most subsequent brk growth occurs while computing CASE and Decimal-to-Decimal downscaling upstream of the sort.

memory.scope: Four separate diagnostic processes. VmHWM includes input setup, full-value validation, warmups, planning and execution; it is not an isolated execution-phase peak. Live RSS is sampled while paused after the execution interval. Snapshot timings are excluded from controlled performance results.

limitations: Diagnostic links move code; compare threshold settings in the same diagnostic binary. The original after-binary is only a link control in the primary series.
The 64 MiB setting reduces COUNT execution work here but increases process memory high-water and page faults; it does not fix heap-return variability.
Memory high-water includes setup, validation and warmups, and has only two fresh processes per threshold. Live RSS after execution is not peak memory.
No spilling, constrained-memory or concurrent-query workload is evaluated. No new global default, cache, allocator setting or complete Spark compatibility claim follows.

No new runtime code changed, so earlier full Spark and lifecycle checks remain those recorded in the referenced artifact; only the two sort configurations and the 66 benchmark observations were revalidated here.

import hashlib, json, os, selectors, signal, statistics, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
p = Path(__file__).parent
old = p.parent / 'decimal-double-dispatch-4826390'
variant, label = sys.argv[1:3]
out = p / f'{label}-{variant}'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
fds = []
proc = tracer = None
tracer_path = p.parent / 'integral-allocator-2cc3024/tools/strace'
base = os.environ.copy()
assert not any(k.startswith(('MALLOC_', 'GLIBC_', 'LD_PRELOAD', 'DECIMAL_BENCH_')) for k in base)
env = {'DECIMAL_BENCH_RETAIN': 'none', 'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_DIR': str(out), 'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_PHASE': 'execution'}
binary = old / f'{variant}-bench'
cmd = ['taskset', '-c', '2', str(binary), str(out / 'capture.json'), 'subqueries', 'correlated_count_ansitrue']
def snapshot():
    maps = Path(f'/proc/{proc.pid}/maps').read_text()
    return {'maps': maps, 'heap_end': int(next(l.split()[0].split('-')[1] for l in maps.splitlines() if '[heap]' in l), 16), 'status': Path(f'/proc/{proc.pid}/status').read_text()}
try:
    for name in ['control','ack']:
        os.mkfifo(out/name)
        fds.append(os.open(out/name,os.O_RDWR|os.O_NONBLOCK))
    with selectors.DefaultSelector() as selector, (out/'stderr.txt').open('w') as stderr, (out/'tracer-stderr.txt').open('w') as trace_stderr:
        selector.register(fds[0], selectors.EVENT_READ)
        proc = subprocess.Popen(cmd,env=base|env,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=stderr,start_new_session=True)
        snapshots = {}
        deadline = time.monotonic()+110
        while len(snapshots)<2:
            assert time.monotonic()<deadline, 'timeout'
            assert proc.poll() is None, (proc.returncode, (out/'stderr.txt').read_text())
            if not selector.select(timeout=.1):
                continue
            command = os.read(fds[0],4096).decode()
            assert command == ('enable\n' if not snapshots else 'disable\n'), command
            snapshots[command.strip()] = snapshot()
            if command == 'enable\n':
                trace_cmd = [str(tracer_path),'-f','-qq','-ttt','-T','-k','--stack-trace-frame-limit=32','-e','trace=brk','-o',str(out/'syscalls.txt'),'-p',str(proc.pid)]
                tracer = subprocess.Popen(trace_cmd,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=trace_stderr)
                for _ in range(100):
                    if int(next(l.split()[1] for l in Path(f'/proc/{proc.pid}/status').read_text().splitlines() if l.startswith('TracerPid:'))):
                        break
                    assert tracer.poll() is None, (out/'tracer-stderr.txt').read_text()
                    time.sleep(.01)
                else:
                    raise RuntimeError('tracer did not attach')
            else:
                tracer.send_signal(signal.SIGINT)
                tracer.wait(timeout=10)
            os.write(fds[1],b'ack\n')
        assert proc.wait(timeout=30)==0, (out/'stderr.txt').read_text()
    cap=json.loads((out/'capture.json').read_text())
    expected=next(r for r in json.loads((old/f'{variant}-subquery-check.json').read_text())['results'] if r['id']=='correlated_count_ansitrue')
    assert len(cap['results']) == 1
    assert all(cap['results'][0][k] == v for k,v in expected.items())
    record={'variant':variant,'command':cmd,'trace_command':trace_cmd,'environment':env,'capture':cap,'snapshots':snapshots,'binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'tracer_sha256':hashlib.sha256(tracer_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'trace_sha256':hashlib.sha256((out/'syscalls.txt').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'trace_exit':tracer.returncode,'scope':'Tracing attaches only while child is paused before the nine execution samples, and detaches at the end handshake. Traced elapsed times are not performance measurements.'}
    (out/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
    print('validated',out,'brk calls',sum(' brk(' in s for s in (out/'syscalls.txt').read_text().splitlines()),flush=True)
finally:
    if tracer is not None and tracer.poll() is None:
        tracer.send_signal(signal.SIGINT)
        try: tracer.wait(timeout=5)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: tracer.kill(); tracer.wait()
    if proc is not None and proc.poll() is None:
        os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGKILL);proc.wait()
    for fd in fds:
        os.close(fd)

import collections, hashlib, json, re
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(__file__).parent
frames=[];frame_ids={};stacks=[];stack_ids={};runs=[]
def classify(text, delta):
    if delta<0:
        if 'drop_glue::<datafusion_physical_plan::sorts::builder::BatchBuilder>' in text: return 'merge_batch_release'
        if 'drop_glue::<datafusion_physical_plan::sorts::merge::SortPreservingMergeStream<' in text: return 'merge_cursor_release'
        if 'ExternalSorter>::sort_batch_stream' in text: return 'local_sort_input_release'
        if 'HashJoinStream>::poll_next_impl' in text: return 'join_temporary_release'
        if 'CastExpr as' in text: return 'cast_input_release'
        if 'decimal_bench::consume' in text: return 'consumer_result_release'
        return 'other_release'
    if delta>0:
        if 'make_downscaler<' in text: return 'decimal_downscale_output'
        if 'CaseBody>::expr_or_expr' in text:
            return 'case_merge_output' if 'arrow_select::merge::merge' in text else 'case_working_buffer'
        if 'interleave_primitive' in text: return 'sort_merge_output'
        if 'sort_batch_chunked' in text or 'ExternalSorter>::sort_batch_stream' in text: return 'local_sort_buffer'
        if 'HashJoinStream>::poll_next_impl' in text: return 'join_buffer'
        return 'other_growth'
    return 'unchanged_break'
for name in ['stack0-after','stack1-before','stack2-before','stack3-after']:
    d=p/name
    meta=json.loads((d/'result.json').read_text())
    text=(d/'syscalls.txt').read_text();assert hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()==meta['trace_sha256']
    previous=meta['snapshots']['enable']['heap_end'];events=[];groups=collections.defaultdict(lambda:{'calls':0,'bytes':0});examples={}
    for block in re.split(r'(?=^\d+\s+\d+\.\d+ brk\()',text,flags=re.M):
        if not block.strip():continue
        m=re.match(r'^(\d+)\s+(\d+\.\d+) brk\((0x[0-9a-f]+|NULL)\) = (0x[0-9a-f]+) <([\d.]+)>',block)
        assert m,block[:200]
        current=int(m[4],16);delta=current-previous;previous=current
        stack=[]
        for line in block.splitlines()[1:]:
            if not line.strip():continue
            assert line.startswith(' > '),line
            line=re.sub(r'/home/hanbo/[^\s(]+/(before|after)-bench', '$binary',line)
            if line not in frame_ids:frame_ids[line]=len(frames);frames.append(line)
            stack.append(frame_ids[line])
        key=tuple(stack)
        if key not in stack_ids:stack_ids[key]=len(stacks);stacks.append(stack)
        category=classify(block,delta)
        groups[category]['calls']+=1;groups[category]['bytes']+=abs(delta)
        event={'timestamp':m[2],'requested':m[3],'returned':m[4],'delta_bytes':delta,'stack':stack_ids[key],'category':category}
        events.append(event);examples.setdefault(category,event)
    assert len(events)==text.count(' brk(')
    assert previous==meta['snapshots']['disable']['heap_end']
    compact={k:v for k,v in meta.items() if k not in ['snapshots','capture']}
    compact['case']=meta['capture']['results'][0]
    compact['case'].pop('planning_samples_ms',None);compact['case'].pop('samples_ms',None)
    compact.update(name=name,initial_heap_end=hex(meta['snapshots']['enable']['heap_end']),final_heap_end=hex(previous),groups=dict(groups),events=events,examples=examples)
    runs.append(compact)
summary=collections.defaultdict(lambda:{'calls':0,'bytes':0})
for r in runs:
    for k,v in r['groups'].items():
        for field,x in v.items():summary[k][field]+=x
result={'scope':'Four complete, execution-only strace -k captures of frozen binaries. Heap return is attributed to the free that triggers brk, not to the size or ownership of every coalesced allocation. Frame symbols may name identical-code aliases; types come from the physical plan and source, not generic drop symbol names. Traced timings are excluded.','frames':frames,'stacks':stacks,'runs':runs,'total_groups':dict(summary)}
(p/'stacks-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print('frames',len(frames),'stacks',len(stacks))
for r in runs:print(r['name'],len(r['events']),json.dumps(r['groups']))
print('Total',json.dumps(summary,indent=2))

from pathlib import Path
p = Path(__file__).parent
old = p.parent / 'decimal-double-dispatch-4826390'
previous = p.parent / 'decimal-double-dispatch-profile-4826390'
sha = lambda f: hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
artifacts = [json.loads(line) for line in (old / 'cargo.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
target = p.parent / 'integer-widening-sparse-owned-542a847/target/release'
sysroot = subprocess.check_output(['rustc','--print','sysroot'],text=True).strip()
cmd = ['rustc','--crate-name','decimal_bench','--edition=2024','-C','opt-level=3','-C','embed-bitcode=no','-C','linker=cc','-C','link-arg=-fuse-ld=lld','-C',f'link-arg=-B{sysroot}/lib/rustlib/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin/gcc-ld','-L',f'dependency={target/"deps"}']
libs = json.loads((previous/'layout-build.json').read_text())['libraries']
for name in ['arrow','datafusion','delta_arrow_reader','futures_util','sail_common','sail_common_datafusion','sail_plan','sail_sql_analyzer','serde_json','tokio','delta_kernel','parquet']:
    rows = [r for r in artifacts if r.get('reason') == 'compiler-artifact' and r['target']['name'] == name]
    assert len(rows)==1,(name,len(rows))
    lib = next(Path(f) for f in rows[0]['filenames'] if f.endswith('.rlib'))
    assert sha(lib)==libs[str(lib)],name
    cmd += ['--extern', f'{name}={lib}']
for path in sorted({path for r in artifacts if r.get('reason')=='build-script-executed' for path in r.get('linked_paths',[])}):
    cmd += ['-L',path]
cmd += [str(p/'decimal_bench.rs'),'-o',str(p/'sort-diagnostic')]
with (p/'build.log').open('w') as log:

import json, os, statistics, subprocess
from pathlib import Path

p = Path(__file__).parent
output = p / 'measurements'
output.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
binaries = {'frozen': p.parent / 'decimal-double-dispatch-4826390/after-bench',
            'merge_1m': p / 'sort-diagnostic', 'concat_64m': p / 'sort-diagnostic'}
extras = {'frozen': {}, 'merge_1m': {'DECIMAL_BENCH_SORT_THRESHOLD': '1048576'},
          'concat_64m': {'DECIMAL_BENCH_SORT_THRESHOLD': '67108864'}}
canonical = {r['id']: r for r in json.loads((p / 'check-1048576.json').read_text())['results']}
cases = ['wide_projection_ansitrue', 'correlated_count_ansitrue']
variants = list(binaries)
runs = []
assert not any(k.startswith(('MALLOC_', 'GLIBC_', 'LD_PRELOAD', 'DECIMAL_BENCH_')) for k in os.environ)
for cycle in range(4):
    order = variants if cycle % 2 == 0 else variants[::-1]
    for variant in order:
        for case in cases[cycle % 2:] + cases[:cycle % 2]:
            d = output / f'{cycle}-{variant}-{case}'
            d.mkdir()
            for name in ['control', 'ack']:
                os.mkfifo(d / name)
            command = ['perf', 'stat', '--delay=-1', f'--control=fifo:{d}/control,{d}/ack',
                       '--json-output', '-o', str(d / 'counters.jsonl'), '-e',
                       '{instructions:u,cycles:u},task-clock:u,context-switches:u,cpu-migrations:u,page-faults:u',
                       '--', 'taskset', '-c', '2', str(binaries[variant]), str(d / 'capture.json'), 'subqueries', case]
            env = os.environ | extras[variant] | {'DECIMAL_BENCH_RETAIN': 'none', 'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_DIR': str(d), 'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_PHASE': 'execution'}
            process = subprocess.run(command, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=120)
            capture = json.loads((d / 'capture.json').read_text())['results'][0]
            assert all(capture[k] == value for k, value in canonical[case].items())
            assert capture['retention'] == 'none' and capture['retained_rows'] == 0
            counters = [json.loads(line) for line in (d / 'counters.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('{')]
            assert len(counters) == 6 and all(row['pcnt-running'] == 100 for row in counters)
            assert process.stderr.count('Events enabled') == 1 and len(capture['samples_ms']) == 9
            runs.append({'cycle': cycle, 'variant': variant, 'case': case, 'command': command,
                         'environment_overrides': extras[variant], 'capture': capture, 'counters': counters, 'median_ms': statistics.median(capture['samples_ms'])})
        print(cycle, variant, flush=True)
    (p / 'measurements.json').write_text(json.dumps({'cases': cases, 'variants': variants, 'runs': runs}, indent=2) + '\n')
summary = {}
for case in cases:
    summary[case] = {}
    for variant in variants:
        rows = [r for r in runs if r['case'] == case and r['variant'] == variant]
        counts = {c['event']: statistics.median(float(next(x['counter-value'] for x in r['counters'] if x['event'] == c['event'])) for r in rows) for c in rows[0]['counters']}
        summary[case][variant] = {'median_ms': statistics.median(r['median_ms'] for r in rows),
                                  'process_medians_ms': [r['median_ms'] for r in rows], 'counters': counts}
    print(case, {k: v['median_ms'] for k, v in summary[case].items()}, flush=True)
(p / 'timing-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + '\n')

import json,os,selectors,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(__file__).parent
root=p/'memory';root.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
canonical=next(r for r in json.loads((p/'check-1048576.json').read_text())['results'] if r['id']=='correlated_count_ansitrue')
base=os.environ.copy();assert not any(k.startswith(('MALLOC_','GLIBC_','LD_PRELOAD','DECIMAL_BENCH_')) for k in base)
runs=[]
def snapshot(pid):
    proc=Path('/proc')/str(pid)
    def fields(file):return {line.split(':')[0]:int(line.split()[1]) for line in (proc/file).read_text().splitlines() if line.endswith(' kB')}
    stat=(proc/'stat').read_text();stats=stat[stat.rindex(')')+2:].split()
    return {'status_kib':fields('status'),'smaps_kib':fields('smaps_rollup'),'minor_faults':int(stats[7]),'major_faults':int(stats[9])}
for i,threshold in enumerate([1048576,67108864,67108864,1048576]):
    out=root/f'{i}-{threshold}';out.mkdir();fds=[];proc=None
    env={'DECIMAL_BENCH_SORT_THRESHOLD':str(threshold),'DECIMAL_BENCH_RETAIN':'none','DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_DIR':str(out),'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_PHASE':'execution'}
    cmd=['taskset','-c','2',str(p/'sort-diagnostic'),str(out/'capture.json'),'subqueries','correlated_count_ansitrue']
    try:
        for name in ['control','ack']:
            os.mkfifo(out/name);fds.append(os.open(out/name,os.O_RDWR|os.O_NONBLOCK))
        with selectors.DefaultSelector() as selector,(out/'stderr.txt').open('w') as stderr:
            selector.register(fds[0],selectors.EVENT_READ)
            proc=subprocess.Popen(cmd,env=base|env,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=stderr)
            snapshots={};deadline=time.monotonic()+60
            while len(snapshots)<2:
                assert time.monotonic()<deadline,'timeout'
                assert proc.poll() is None,(proc.returncode,(out/'stderr.txt').read_text())
                if not selector.select(timeout=.1):continue
                command=os.read(fds[0],4096).decode()
                assert command==('enable\n' if not snapshots else 'disable\n'),command
                snapshots[command.strip()]=snapshot(proc.pid)
                os.write(fds[1],b'ack\n')
            assert proc.wait(timeout=30)==0,(out/'stderr.txt').read_text()
        capture=json.loads((out/'capture.json').read_text())['results'][0]
        assert all(capture[k]==v for k,v in canonical.items())
        runs.append({'threshold_bytes':threshold,'command':cmd,'environment':env,'snapshots':snapshots,'capture':capture})
        print(threshold,'HWM KiB',snapshots['disable']['status_kib']['VmHWM'],'RSS KiB',snapshots['disable']['smaps_kib']['Rss'],flush=True)
    finally:
        if proc is not None and proc.poll() is None:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        for fd in fds:os.close(fd)
(p/'memory.json').write_text(json.dumps({'scope':'Four separate diagnostic processes. VmHWM includes input setup, full-value validation, warmups, planning and execution; it is not an isolated execution-phase peak. Live RSS is sampled while paused after the execution interval. Snapshot timings are excluded from controlled performance results.','runs':runs},indent=2)+'\n')
